name: mastermind-ad-engine
description: Create and evaluate static ads with Mastermind's seven-stage creative workflow, evidence-aware claims, symbolic visual design, platform adaptation, critique and controlled A/B variants.

interface.longDescription: Create compelling static billboard, poster, print and social ad concepts using a structured seven-step method. Find an emotional truth, check product claims, flip category assumptions, choose an ownable visual symbol, adapt to the placement and test ideas critically. Produces image or editable SVG mockups when the OpenAI environment supports artifact creation, with an explicit fallback to detailed layout instructions otherwise. Generates controlled A/B variants and critiques existing ads. AI creative ratings are subjective, not validated campaign performance. No advertising platform, external service, or MCP connection is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Make a 48-sheet billboard for a bookkeeping service aimed at anxious freelancers.
Create a café poster for night-shift nurses. Show a person.
Critique an existing ad and separate observations from your opinion.
Generate four controlled Instagram A/B ad variants.
